mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the process of determining the extent to which these desired behavioral changes have been accomplished in ways of thinking, feeling and acting.
Extension evaluation is the process of determining the extent to which these desired behavioral changes have been accomplished in ways of thinking, feeling and acting.
Fill in the blank: ______ means ·to appraise carefully, and it not only helps to determine the effectiveness of a program but also clarifies what is really being done and how it is done.
Evaluation means ·to appraise carefully, and it not only helps to determine the effectiveness of a program but also clarifies what is really being done and how it is done.
Fill in the blank: ______ may be defined as any aspect of a situation, event, or object that is invested with a preferential interest of being "good," "bad," "desirable," "undesirable," or the like.
Value may be defined as any aspect of a situation, event, or object that is invested with a preferential interest of being "good," "bad," "desirable," "undesirable," or the like.
Fill in the blank: ______ are known, whereas tomorrow's problems are not so well known and are likely to differ in scope and, perhaps, in nature.
Today's problems are known, whereas tomorrow's problems are not so well known and are likely to differ in scope and, perhaps, in nature.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a process of staff development for the purpose of improving the performance of an incumbent holding a position with assigned job responsibilities.
In-service training is a process of staff development for the purpose of improving the performance of an incumbent holding a position with assigned job responsibilities.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a strategy or tactic that a trainer uses to deliver the content so that the trainees achieve the objective.
A training method is a strategy or tactic that a trainer uses to deliver the content so that the trainees achieve the objective.
fib: ______ is a process through which individuals are made ready to enter a certain kind of professional job such as agriculture, medicine or engineering.
Pre-service training is a process through which individuals are made ready to enter a certain kind of professional job such as agriculture, medicine or engineering.
______ is the process of acquiring specific skills to perform a job better (Jucious, 1963).
Training is the process of acquiring specific skills to perform a job better (Jucious, 1963).
______ is the best means of meeting this shortage.
Training on a continuous basis is the best means of meeting this shortage.
______ is the keystone upon which the extension service is built.
Leadership is the keystone upon which the extension service is built.
______ is responsible for helping farmers make efficient use of land, labour, and capital to meet the nation's food needs.
The extension service is responsible for helping farmers make efficient use of land, labour, and capital to meet the nation's food needs.
